title: Saudi Arabian Flatbread Pizza
description: A fusion of Italian and Middle Eastern flavors, this loaded flatbread pizza is topped with creamy cheese and a hint of Arabian spices.
instructions: Brush the flatbread with olive oil and sprinkle with minced garlic.
Spread the Arabian cheese over the flatbread, leaving a 1/2-inch border around the edges.
Drizzle the luxuriously loaded cream over the cheese.
Sprinkle chopped parsley over the top (if using).
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Cut the flatbread into wedges or slices and serve immediately.
